data.summary: 6+ years of experience in Data Engineering and Machine Learning Operations (MLOps) with strong expertise in building, deploying, and monitoring ML pipelines across AWS and distributed systems. Skilled in Python, PySpark, MLflow, Airflow, Docker, SageMaker, Bedrock, and Generative AI frameworks (LangChain, RAG, Vector Databases, and LLMs like Sonnet 3.5) with hands-on experience in ML algorithms, Scikit-learn, and data-driven automation. Proven ability to bridge the gap between data engineering and AI/ML lifecycle, delivering scalable, production-ready ML and GenAI solutions.

Banking Sector

Enhanced fraud detection model accuracy by 15% via feature engineering and hyperparameter tuning.
Pragma Software Systems
Jul 2019 – Dec 2020 | Pune, India
Developed insurance claim processing workflows with database integration.
Implemented data migration pipelines and automated reporting using SQL & Python.
Collaborated with business teams to transition from legacy systems to modern data- driven platforms.
